facts.fact: A decree numbered 2025-1959 on the institutional framework of interoperability in Madagascar is listed on the OITF legal portal; the page gives only the title, no text and no adoption day, so the date is the page's published date of December 2025.
facts.system: Décret N° 2025-1959 relatif au cadre institutionnel de l'interopérabilité

note: Title-only page; no text on who must follow the decree or who enforces it, so no fact on use.
